prompt: Who won the 2016 Wisden-MCC (Melbourne Cricket Council) Cricket Photograph of the Year?
answer: Saqib Majeed, a freelance photographer from Srinagar, won the 2016 Wisden–MCC Cricket Photograph of the Year award. His winning photograph showed boys playing cricket in Srinagar’s Nishat Bagh gardens.
